company: The Bucher Honey Co. Pest Control

reviews.text: I had the pleasure of meeting jaret he was very professional and did a wonderful job spraying for spiders and other insects I had other companies spray before but with Jared in was a much better job with much much better results and price competitive
reviews.author: Darryn K.

reviews.text: Exceptional service. Jared came out quickly and took care of a swarm of yellow jackets that was in our house. Gave great information and checked back in to ensure the swarm was completely gone. Wouldn’t use anyone else!
reviews.author: Jennifer E.

reviews.text: Very fast service, professional and extremely knowledgeable. Took care of a yellow jacket nest right by our front door. Guaranteed his work but so far doesn’t look like we need any additional visits. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: michelle S.
